checks: Compare only local changes; cancel preserves textarea/cursor and latest deleted/added drafts
Failed comparison read keeps conflict action, current DOM and inputs available for a direct retry
Recovery failure and file fallback preserve inputs; retry copies all changes exactly and resumes active caret
New conflict uses the successful recovery as baseline; deterministic second-tab race creates no partial copy
Unapplied attachments and IME block recovery comparison until inputs are accepted
A reverted local change reloads latest drafts without making unnecessary copies
Full latest storage keeps all local input and file fallback until another tab frees capacity
Input typed during an unfinished save is compared against the actual persisted payload
